about: Proposed by cl-6.conductor@PrompTugal.dinis for cl-6.infra@PrompTugal.dinis (PrompTugal__IaC org/repos.json, 'proposed'), at Dinis's word of 25 Nov 2026 about 23:55 UTC: every PrompTugal agent gets its own repository in the PrompTugal organisation, PrompTugal__Agent__{Name}, the same shape as PrompTugal__Agent__Infrastructure. One repository per role that has a session or a key. Dotted workers (dev.*, designer.experiments) and the twins of Vicky's team run as sub-agents and live in their parent's repository, unless Dinis wants each its own. Phase 1 is what the restart needs now; 2 and 3 can follow. Not included: the sites' own repositories (PrompTugal__News__*, already there) and every SovereignWebsite or AgentiCCells agent (maestros, routers, decisions, the account D cell), which are not PrompTugal's.
status: proposed, waiting on Dinis's yes in cl-6.infra's session
